remote_dispatch.note: Remote node dispatch (references/25): transports existing PM-harness authority via a one-time receipt consumed by the remote spawn-worker.sh. It does not add a new host key and does not widen any chain intersection; set enabled=false to reject all remote dispatch on this node.
